# Golden frames for wire protocol v1 (docs/protocol.md). One frame per message type.
# Both codecs read this file: firmware/tests/test_main.cpp (golden_frames) and
# backend/tests/test_protocol.py (test_golden_frames). Each must decode every frame, find
# device ECU-GOLD, seq 0x01020304, ts_ms 1700000000123, fw 1.2.3, and re-encode it to the same bytes.
# Format: name, then the whole frame in hex.
